summary: Adds journal_entries.prior_period_through (nullable date), a presentation flag: statements show flagged entries, conversion re-posts and reversals of entries dated on or before the cutoff apart from the month's operating results, on a 'Prior-period items recorded this month' line; year to date keeps them in their accounts. Backfills Canyon Gate's eleven manual corrections of pre-cutover activity (reserve reclassifications as re-posted 10/11: JE-2026-00488, 490, 492, 494, 496, 498, 504; corrections JE-2026-00415, 429, 435, 505) with 2026-07-31. No amount, account, fund or date changes; posts nothing.
